app.name: WC04 Camera (USB experimental)
app.long_description: PRIVATE LOCAL TEST: font redistribution rights unverified. 0.3.4 normalizes only 1-7 zero bytes after JPEG EOI on eight-byte-aligned frames, retains full decoding, and adds 1 KiB of shared frame headroom (615424-byte cap). Experimental generic UVC 1.0 MJPEG discovery; 0.3.2 captured photos and silent video at 320x240 on 0c45:6366; this experimental build awaits testing. One active configuration, 320x240/640x480 and interval-1 isochronous IN only. Newer UVC versions, bulk, YUYV, audio and proprietary cameras are unsupported. IOS58 and writable SD required to save. A opens live view; 1 changes size; 2 checks camera; + selects Photo/Video; left/right selects Off/3/5/10 second timer. Photo: A captures, B cancels countdown or returns to menu. Video: A starts/stops silent sampled MJPEG AVI, max 60 seconds/128 MiB. HOME finalizes and exits. Host-tested and compiled, this USB experiment awaits physical Wii testing. If USB stopping waits, unplug camera. Temporary icon: Giuseppe Ramos / Vecteezy.com; see included licenses.
